name: bracket_completion
description: Complete a nested bracket string by outputting missing closing delimiters in reverse order; controls copy explicit closing suffix.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
pairs=dict(zip('([{',')]}'))
for i in range(120):
 opens=''.join(random.choice('([{') for _ in range(random.randint(2,5))); suffix=''.join(pairs[x] for x in opens[::-1]); payload=random.choice(['x','y','a','b','0','1'])
 prefix='Complete the brackets. Write only the missing closing brackets.\nSequence: '+opens+payload
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'\nClosing brackets:','answer':' '+suffix})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'\nCopy this closing suffix: '+suffix+'\nClosing brackets:','answer':' '+suffix})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
